narrative.overview: Typpy looks like a friendly shelf of small games in a warm room: cream and rose surfaces, one bright red, soft rounded cards, and big confident black-weight titles. Calm modes and timed modes share the same shelf, so the interface stays inviting rather than tense.
keyCharacteristics: Rose-cream surfaces with red as the only saturated chrome hue
32px container radii, pill chips and primary button
Tonal depth with a single pink hairline

rules.name: The Signal Red Rule
rules.body: Red marks one thing at a time: the logo, the current location, or the next action.

rules.name: The Warm Silver Rule
rules.body: #91918c is never text. Use Olive Gray for any muted words.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Only Plus Jakarta Sans for UI. Monospace is allowed solely for the typing area.

rules.name: The Tint-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with a surface step and a hairline, not with a bigger shadow.

dos: Do use tailwind.config.cjs color tokens instead of raw hex.
Do use Olive Gray (#62625b) for any muted text.
Do keep red to the logo, the current location and the next action.
Do give every interactive element a visible :focus-visible ring.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion in all game and hover animation.
donts: Don't use gradient text on titles.
Don't use thick colored side borders on callouts or cards.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing.
Don't set text in Warm Silver (#91918c).
Don't add yellow or orange page gradients.
